purpose: Portable, verifiable, multi-surface public atlas with independent recovery
source_of_truth: versioned evidence records and signed or hash-checked manifests, not website HTML

surfaces.role: navigable, accessible atlas; progressive loading and deep links
source, history, reproducible builds and provenance
serve same verified release without primary site
offline browse and restore, subject to authorization

replication_rules: Replicas must be independently retrievable and hash checked
Copies on one provider or credential boundary do not count as independent failure domains
Public fragments may link to restricted nodes but must not reveal their content or identifiers
A fragment carries enough context to find its parent, evidence and fallback without embedding the entire graph
Rendering failures degrade to plain text and source links
Replicas report lag and mismatched release IDs explicitly
Backups require demonstrated restore, not just successful upload
No automatic publication of private emails, chats, or media without authorization
acceptance_gates: Generate one deterministic release from a public evidence graph
Verify identical manifest digests at two independently hosted endpoints
Open one nested diagram and follow its source evidence
Disable primary site and browse the mirror
Restore a previous release from offline archive
Detect stale or tampered replica and refuse silent promotion
Pass accessible keyboard-only and low-bandwidth navigation
next_executable: Build static, content-addressed atlas from existing public frontier index; test deterministic output before hosting
limitations: No website deployment, mirror, backup or restore is claimed by this contract
